newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha eases in line with softer crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha eases in line with softer crude.

text.p: NWE naphtha eased on Tuesday in line with slightly weaker crude futures in a moribund market, traders said.
May swaps were talked around $178/$180, while June paper was assessed at around $183/$183.50. Traders attributed the weaker prices to slightly lower crude futures prices.
"Yesterday's gains had nothing to do with physical activity, it was all off crude and now its rally is looking slightly fragile the market's off," said one.
On the physical front the market was extremely quiet, traders said.
